items.title: Enhance Browser Functionality with New Modifiers and Upload Modes in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces critical enhancements to the browser functionality, including new `press.modifiers` for basic editor operations, an `upload.mode: 'drop'` to prevent site freezes, and a `tabs action=list_popups` to ensure proper popup handling. These changes improve user experience and system reliability by addressing previously unexpressed actions and potential deadlocks during file uploads.

items.title: Enhance Keyboard and Popup Functionality in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces significant improvements to keyboard shortcuts, allowing modifier keys to be recognized correctly. It also adds a new entry point for managing popups, ensuring they can be claimed effectively. Additionally, drag-and-drop support for file uploads has been implemented, enhancing user experience and functionality.

items.title: Enhance iframe handling with recursive attachment in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a robust solution for handling nested iframes by ensuring that child frames are properly attached and reported. Key changes include modifications to the auto-attach mechanism and the addition of blocked frame reporting, which enhances the model's understanding of inaccessible content. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the stability of these enhancements.

items.title: Enhance wait functionality with new modes in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces three new modes for the `wait` function: `element`, `element_gone`, and `network_idle`. These enhancements allow for more robust waiting conditions beyond just text, improving the handling of UI elements and network requests. The changes ensure that elements like loading spinners and buttons can be effectively waited on, preventing premature actions during uploads.

items.title: Enhance wait functionality with new modes in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces three new modes for the `wait` function: `element`, `element_gone`, and `network_idle`, enhancing its capability to handle various web automation scenarios. Additionally, the URL matching has been improved to support prefix matching, ensuring better compatibility with SPA routing. The changes are backed by comprehensive tests, all of which passed successfully.

items.title: Removed browser.batch Implementation for Stability in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the `browser.batch` implementation due to its consistent failure in production. The change includes the deletion of the `batch()` function and related dispatch cases, ensuring that the system avoids misleading success states. The version has been updated from 0.7.13 to 0.7.14, with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Streamline Browser Commands in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the `browser.batch` command and four redundant null fields from the payload, enhancing the clarity and efficiency of the command structure. Additionally, the `browser.type` now includes a `delay_ms` parameter to support gradual input, which was previously implemented but not declared in the schema. These changes aim to prevent errors and improve the overall functionality of the platform.

items.title: Enhance Input Handling and Fix Contenteditable Issues in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the input handling in the extension by ensuring that the `browser.type` function simulates key-by-key input correctly, addressing issues with rich-text editors. Additionally, it modifies the `fill` function to prevent accidental clearing of entire documents in contenteditable elements. The changes enhance user experience and data integrity across various text editors.

items.title: Fix missing sender key for email templates in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a missing internationalization key for the 'sender' label in email templates, which was previously rendering as a literal string. The key has been added for ten languages, ensuring proper localization across the platform. All tests for internationalization coverage and linting have passed successfully.

items.title: remove problematic browser.batch command in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the `browser.batch` command from the Skills documentation and related files due to its 100% failure rate in production. Key changes include deletions from `SKILL.md`, the browser manifest, and test files, ensuring that the model no longer teaches this unreliable command. This adjustment prevents potential errors and enhances the overall reliability of the Skills framework.

items.title: Refactor tenant labels to derive from service in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the tenant label handling in the deployment process, ensuring that labels are derived from the service alias instead of hardcoded values. The change aligns the appliance provider with existing helm configurations, enhancing consistency and maintainability. Additionally, it consolidates the use of the 'wisdom' literal across multiple files into named constants, improving code clarity.

items.title: Refactor WeChat Login Panel for Better Structure in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update extracts the WeChat login panel from the shared management page, significantly reducing its complexity. The `Manage.vue` file has been streamlined from 2171 to 1599 lines, enhancing maintainability and performance. The new WeChat component is fully functional and has passed all existing contract tests, ensuring a smooth transition.

items.title: Streamline Deployment Logic with Provider Registry in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new provider registry for deployment workloads, reducing the number of manual if-branches from 14 to just 1. Each provider now explicitly declares its supported operations, ensuring that unimplemented operations return a clear error instead of silently falling back to incorrect paths. The changes enhance code maintainability and improve error handling for deployment operations.

items.title: Streamlined Email Campaign Process in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update simplifies the email marketing wizard by removing the redundant fourth step for SMTP campaigns, allowing for a more efficient four-step process. Additionally, it enhances error reporting for scheduling campaigns, providing clearer feedback on provider identity issues. The changes also ensure that Tencent SES retains its independent step due to its manual template approval requirement.

items.title: Streamlined Email Campaign Wizard to 4 Steps + Bulk Recipient Selection in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update simplifies the email campaign creation process by reducing the wizard from 6 to 4 steps, enhancing user experience. It introduces bulk selection for recipients, allowing users to manage large lists more efficiently. Additionally, various UI elements and translations have been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring a smoother workflow for email marketing tasks.

items.title: Unify Deployment Status Handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses inconsistencies in how the `degraded` status is interpreted across different pages. A new utility file has been introduced to standardize deployment status semantics, ensuring that `degraded` is treated as a transitional state rather than a failure. As a result, users will no longer see false failure messages during deployment, improving the overall user experience.

items.title: Fix SMTP Credentials for Email Scheduling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the API pod lacked SMTP credentials, causing email scheduling to fail with a 'provider identity is not enabled for sending' error. The deployment configuration has been updated to include the necessary SMTP environment variables, ensuring consistency between the API and worker pods. Additionally, a new test has been added to verify that both pods reference the same SMTP credentials.

items.title: Enhance Debugger Recovery Logic in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue causing the debugger to enter a stale target loop when detaching from tabs. Key changes include improved handling of detach reasons, a new recovery method for reattaching the debugger after a service worker restart, and enhanced navigation indicators. These modifications aim to ensure smoother user experiences and reduce session interruptions.

items.title: Align CLI Defaults with OpenAPI for Kling in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the default request fields for the Kling CLI with the current OpenAPI specifications. Key changes include aligning default values for options in the lip-sync and talking-photo commands, ensuring backward compatibility while improving consistency. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate the default payload serialization, enhancing the reliability of the CLI.

items.title: Sync AiChat V2 Schema with OpenAPI Standards in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the AiChat V2 schema with the latest OpenAPI specifications, ensuring consistency across the platform. Key changes include the removal of outdated model entries, adjustments to message typing, and the addition of numeric bounds for request parameters. Contract tests have also been updated to reflect these changes, enhancing the reliability of the implementation.

items.title: Fix session expiry handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the `expires_at_ms` field was missing from the `session.start` payload, leading to incorrect session expiry checks. The fix ensures that the `expiry_ms` is now included in the payload, allowing the extension to accurately determine session activity. Additionally, the protocol documentation has been updated to reflect this change, enhancing overall system reliability.

items.title: Fix empty role/name filters in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where the `browser.find` function failed to locate elements due to empty role and name filters being incorrectly processed. Now, empty strings are treated as 'not provided', ensuring that the function can return valid matches. Additionally, a new test case has been added to verify this behavior, contributing to improved reliability in element searching.

items.title: Fix default model value for Kling API in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a default model value for the Kling API, addressing a discrepancy where the model was required but not specified in the API documentation. The change ensures that external clients can make successful requests without explicitly providing the model, thus enhancing usability. The modification does not alter existing required fields or the behavior of Discord commands.

items.title: Enhance Yuque Connector with Cookie Authentication in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new cookie-based authentication method for the Yuque connector, allowing free users to connect without needing a personal access token. Key changes include a migration to rename existing provider entries, updates to connection validation logic, and the addition of comprehensive tests to ensure functionality. The integration of this feature enhances accessibility for users and improves the overall connector experience.

items.title: Fix billing state loss during deployment polling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where the billing state and events were being overwritten during deployment status polling. The fix ensures that these keys are preserved unless explicitly updated, preventing unintended resets and duplicate notifications. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate the preservation of these keys, enhancing the reliability of the deployment process.

items.title: Enhance session loading to show latest messages first in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the user experience by ensuring that when a session is opened, it directly displays the latest messages instead of replaying from the oldest. Key changes include skipping unnecessary historical data requests and implementing a new mechanism to handle session state during relay restarts. The fix enhances performance and reliability, ensuring users see real-time updates without delays.

items.title: Strengthening Browser Extensions for Seamless Site Integration in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive hardening plan for browser extensions, addressing seven active bugs and six capability gaps. Key improvements include automatic reconnection after debugger detachment and ensuring true key-by-key input for rich text editors. The proposed changes aim to enhance robustness, allowing for new site integrations with minimal modifications required.

items.title: Fix AI Agent Card Icon Alignment in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves the alignment issue of the AI Agent card title icon on the WeChat bot management page. The styles for the `.card-title` and `.token-eye` classes have been moved to their respective child components to ensure proper display. The fix enhances the user interface by ensuring icons and titles are correctly aligned across components.

items.title: Fix cookie connection profile display issue in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the identity card was not displaying for cookie connections with profiles. The logic was updated to show the account identity based on data rather than connection type, ensuring that profiles are displayed correctly when available. Additionally, a minor bug related to duplicate status tags on the identity card has been fixed.

items.title: Enhance Cookie Profiles for 7 Platforms in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces cookie profile fetchers for seven additional platforms: Bilibili, Toutiao, Reddit, Habr, Medium, Juejin, and CSDN. Each fetcher has been rigorously tested with real cookies, ensuring accurate identity resolution. The new implementations streamline the process of obtaining user profiles and improve the overall functionality of the cookie connector framework.

items.title: Enhance GitHub Connection Options in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the option to use a Personal Access Token (PAT) alongside OAuth for GitHub connections, allowing for more granular permissions. The documentation has been updated to reflect these changes, including a clear distinction between OAuth-only scopes and PAT guidance. Additionally, verification processes have been improved to ensure YAML frontmatter integrity, preventing silent failures in skill execution.

items.title: Enhance GitHub Connector with PAT Support in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new connection method for the GitHub connector, allowing users to connect via Personal Access Tokens (PAT) in addition to the existing OAuth method. This enhancement enables teams to restrict access to specific repositories, addressing concerns over broad permissions associated with OAuth. The connector's documentation has been updated to clarify the differences between the two methods, ensuring users can make informed choices.

items.title: Fix dark mode styling for WeChat bot config page in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update addresses a styling issue on the WeChat bot deployment configuration page, where the card rendered with a stark white background in dark mode. The hardcoded colors have been replaced with CSS variables to ensure consistent theming across light and dark modes. The changes improve the visual experience and maintain design integrity across different themes.

items.title: Update Subscription Status Label for Clarity in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update modifies the subscription status label from 'Running' to 'Subscribed' to eliminate confusion with the instance deployment status. Changes were made in multiple language files to ensure consistency across the application. The new label enhances user understanding and aligns with the actual subscription state.

items.title: Unify Invoice Statuses and Download Functionality in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses inconsistencies in invoice status labels and colors across multiple pages. Key changes include the introduction of a new component for the invoice status tag, which allows direct download of issued invoices. Additionally, the text for statuses has been standardized for clarity and improved user experience.

items.title: Enhanced Order Management with Pagination and User ID Flexibility in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces pagination support for the order management console, allowing users to view more than 20 orders at a time. The user ID field is now optional, enabling users to browse all recent orders by default. Additionally, routing has been secured with a superuser guard to enhance access control.

items.title: Streamline Unread Notifications in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update simplifies the unread notification system in the Coding Bridge by removing the redundant red dot and relying solely on bold titles to indicate unread items. The font weight for unread items is now set to 700, while read items are at 400, enhancing visibility. All internationalization keys remain unchanged, ensuring a consistent user experience across locales.

items.title: Enhance Cookie Connectors with Profile Fetching in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature for cookie connectors, allowing them to fetch user profiles similar to OAuth connections. By implementing a fetcher for cookie profiles, the system can now display user names and avatars, enhancing user experience. The changes include new modules for profile fetching and extensive tests to ensure reliability and performance.

items.title: Align China Invoice Form with Backend Requirements in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves discrepancies between frontend and backend validations for Chinese VAT invoices. The taxpayer ID is now mandatory, while other fields like company address and phone are optional. This change enhances user experience by clarifying required fields and ensuring smoother invoice processing.

items.title: Streamline China VAT Invoice Requirements in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the billing profile validation for China VAT invoices, ensuring that only the title and tax number are mandatory fields. Other fields such as company address, phone, and bank details are now optional for both general and special invoices. The changes enhance user experience by aligning front-end and back-end validations.

items.title: Fix cover art issue and improve inspection tool in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a bug where the Open button for `/suno` and `/producer` endpoints incorrectly pointed to cover images instead of the actual audio files. Additionally, the inspection tool's criteria have been revamped to ensure accurate reporting, addressing previously ineffective checks. These changes enhance user experience and improve the reliability of service inspections.

items.title: Enhance GitHub Skill with New Features in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces comprehensive recipes for GitHub actions such as starring, watching, forking, and managing notifications, releases, and labels. A new table clarifies the granted scopes, ensuring users understand what actions are supported without unnecessary retries. All changes have been verified against the live API, enhancing the overall functionality and user experience of the GitHub skill.

items.title: Fix sidebar icon and title clipping issues in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical clipping issues in the documentation sidebar, where icons and titles were being cut off. Key changes include adjusting the flex properties and widths to ensure proper display and functionality of the sidebar elements. The fixes have been verified to eliminate clipping and ensure titles display correctly across various viewport sizes.

items.title: Fix execution state issues in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses two critical bugs affecting the browser tool's execution state. It corrects the mismatched key names for successful command sequences and ensures that failed commands are accurately marked as 'failed'. Additionally, it modifies the event emission for terminal states to reflect the actual command outcomes, enhancing the reliability of the execution status displayed in the frontend.

items.title: Streamline browser schema by removing dead fields in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the unused `locator_plan` field from the browser schema, which was causing validation errors during model interactions. Additionally, error messages now include specific field paths to aid in debugging. The changes ensure smoother operations without impacting existing functionality, as the removed field was never utilized.

items.title: Improve session error reporting in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the error reporting for session failures by replacing the generic 'unknown_outcome' with specific contract states. Key changes include new error messages for session expiration, non-existent sessions, and policy mismatches, allowing for clearer diagnostics. The version has been bumped to 0.7.10 to reflect these updates.

items.title: Fix session renewal to prevent command failures in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses session expiration issues causing command failures in the browser. The `ensureSession` method now renews sessions proactively when less than 45 seconds remain, ensuring commands continue to function smoothly. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate the renewal logic and ensure stability.

items.title: Enhance Video Uploads and Fix Delivery Issues in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves video upload handling by dynamically adjusting the size limit based on Discord's settings, allowing for inline playback of larger videos. Additionally, it fixes a critical bug where successful results were not delivered due to an unbound variable, ensuring users receive their artifacts as expected. New tests have been added to validate these changes and prevent future issues.

items.title: Enhance Unread Notifications for History Sessions in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a bold title and a red dot indicator for unread history sessions in the Coding Bridge. Users will now be able to easily identify sessions that have finished while they were away, enhancing their experience across devices. The changes include updates to the HistoryDrawer component and the addition of a new action to mark sessions as read.

items.title: Revamped Adversarial Review Process in Index 🚀
items.summary: The adversarial review process has been updated to operate on an on-demand basis, removing the previous requirement for automatic execution with every PR. Key changes include the removal of related content from AGENTS.md and modifications to several workflow documents to reflect this new optional approach. This aims to reduce unnecessary overhead while maintaining the ability to conduct thorough reviews when needed.

items.title: Enhance default working directory handling in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of default working directories by preventing sessions from running in the filesystem root. The `_safe_default_cwd()` function now correctly falls back to the user's home directory when launched from an OS launcher that provides an unsuitable cwd. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure this functionality works as intended.

items.title: Enhance session visibility in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves the issue where Claude sessions were not visible in the VSCode extension and CLI pickers. By modifying the entrypoint configuration, sessions can now be displayed correctly, ensuring better synchronization across platforms. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate this functionality.

items.title: Fix intermittent identity 404s in Skills 🔧
items.summary: This update addresses the issue of X's identity endpoints returning 404 errors, which were incorrectly attributed to expired cookies. A new retry mechanism has been implemented to handle these intermittent failures, allowing up to four retries with fresh client sessions. Additionally, documentation has been updated to clarify that a 404 response does not indicate an authentication error, guiding users to avoid unnecessary reconnections.

items.title: Enhance Cross-Device Unread Marking for History Sessions in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new unread marking system for history sessions that syncs across devices, ensuring that if a session is marked as read on one device, it reflects on all others. Key changes include the implementation of a read watermark stored on the node side, allowing for accurate tracking of session states. The update also includes extensive testing, with all tests passing successfully, ensuring reliability and performance.

items.title: Enhance Image Handling with URL Support in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces support for `image.source.type=url` in the `/v1/messages` endpoint, addressing customer feedback regarding image handling in the Claude models. Key changes include modifications to `handlers/messages.py` for inline processing of external image URLs and updates to `utils/image_inline.py` to ensure compatibility with Anthropic's API requirements. The implementation has been thoroughly tested, resulting in improved functionality without compromising existing features.

items.title: Eliminate Upstream Billing Field Exposure in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the `copilot_usage` field from API responses to prevent the leakage of upstream identity and internal cost models. Key changes include the addition of a sanitization utility that cleanses response bodies across multiple endpoints. The implementation ensures that customer-facing data remains secure without altering existing contracts or dependencies.

items.title: Enhance Xiaohongshu Publishing Guidelines in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update clarifies the requirements for publishing on Xiaohongshu, addressing key issues such as mandatory media for image and video notes, and the correct usage of reference contracts. The documentation has been revised to ensure users understand the conditions for successful publishing, including the need for at least one image or video. Additionally, navigation processes have been streamlined to reduce errors during publishing.

items.title: Enhance Browser Facade Descriptions in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the descriptions for each browser facade in the manifest, ensuring that the model accurately understands where references originate. Key changes include the addition of real descriptions in `manifest.json`, error handling for missing descriptions in `adapter.ts`, and the propagation of these descriptions in `facadeTool.ts`. The modifications enhance the reliability of the browser tools and prevent stale references.

items.title: Fix browser.find issues for seamless publishing in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves critical issues with the `browser.find` functionality, ensuring it correctly retrieves elements by implementing a root node for `Accessibility.queryAXTree`. The changes include modifications to the observation engine and adjustments to the CDP allowlist, enhancing the agent's ability to interact with the page. Additionally, version 0.7.9 has been released, reflecting these improvements.

items.title: Enhance History Filtering by Source in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a new filtering feature for the History Drawer in Nexior, allowing users to filter sessions by source, including Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot. The filter chips display the count of sessions per source and are only shown when there are multiple sources available. Additionally, the update includes various improvements to the UI and internationalization support across multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance Upgrade Documentation and Version Reporting in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the upgrade instructions in the README and service documentation, addressing user confusion about upgrading the service. It adds a `--version` flag to display the installed version, ensuring users can easily verify their installation. Key changes include detailed upgrade commands for various platforms and clarifications on service management during upgrades.

items.title: Enhance Seedream Image Upload and Timeout Settings in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new method for uploading base64 images to COS, significantly improving the handling of large image payloads that previously caused timeouts. The upstream timeout has been increased from 150s to 300s, and the server's request timeout is set to 600s to prevent socket disconnections. These changes aim to enhance the reliability of image processing in the Seedream service.

items.title: Simplified scheduled task authorization and fixed edit-state restores in Nexior 🛠️
items.summary: Scheduled task authorization now relies solely on the allowed skills and MCP server lists, removing the redundant mode field that caused saved permissions to appear empty when editing. The update also prevents binding data from being wiped by waiting for capability loading before saving, improves save-state handling during async operations, and adds comprehensive tests covering regressions and legacy scenarios.

items.title: Expanded Domain Blocklist for Enhanced Security in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update significantly expands the blocked email domains from 6 to 26, aligning with the risk control list to prevent abuse. A new consistency test has been added to ensure that the deployed blocklist covers every domain flagged by the risk assessment. These changes aim to enhance the registration process by preventing accounts from domains previously identified as abusive.

items.title: Enhance Yuque Connector with Cookie Login Support in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces dual authentication modes for the Yuque connector, allowing users to log in using either a personal access token or browser cookies. The change enables free users to access the connector without needing a paid membership, significantly broadening usability. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure functionality and security.

items.title: Streamlined Result Messaging in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the readability of result messages in Discord by removing unnecessary formatting elements such as quotation lines and backticks. Additionally, it introduces spacing between lines for better clarity and removes the Animate button to prevent layout inconsistencies. The changes aim to improve user experience by making messages clearer and more accessible.

items.title: Prevent pinned account fallbacks and keep run records accurate in Platform Service 🛡️
items.summary: Fixed connection binding resolution so pinned accounts are matched from connection identities instead of request aliases and no longer silently fall back to default accounts. Added validation to reject unenforceable remote MCP bindings and improved run history handling when account lookups fail. Updated tests cover deleted connections, MCP bindings, and connection lookup failures.

items.title: Published a comprehensive $ACE research and marketing playbook in Index 📚
items.summary: Added a modular research package covering $ACE token analysis, platform validation, marketing strategy, compliance guidance, execution planning, and reproducible verification steps. The documentation consolidates key business, engineering, and on-chain findings while clearly separating verified facts from open questions and defining pre-launch validation gates for external marketing. It also updates the plans index to surface the new research module and its current status.

items.title: Revamp Protocol Schema for Real Frame Validation in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the browser protocol schema to accurately reflect the frames actually sent by the extension, replacing outdated definitions. Key changes include the addition of real frame types and improved testing to ensure that only valid outputs are validated against the schema. This enhances the reliability of the protocol and addresses previous testing shortcomings.

items.title: Easily Duplicate Scheduled Tasks in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new 'Copy' button for scheduled tasks, allowing users to duplicate existing tasks with pre-filled information in the creation form. The new feature ensures that task names are automatically numbered to avoid conflicts, and authorization for duplicates is set to 30 days. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the functionality and ensure a seamless user experience.

items.title: Sanitize public skill examples and remove hardcoded account data in Skills 🔒
items.summary: Public skill examples across multiple integrations were updated to replace real account identifiers, handles, IDs, counts, and signatures with safe placeholder values. Documentation and CLI examples were aligned to use generic placeholders, optional account assertions where appropriate, and corrected shell-safe syntax. Related tests were updated to use fixed example data, helping prevent accidental reuse of personal information while preserving existing behavior.

items.title: Update CLI for aichat2 to Align with Latest OpenAPI in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the aichat2 CLI options with the latest OpenAPI specifications. Key changes include making the 'QUESTION' argument optional, enhancing stateful flag semantics, and enforcing argument validation based on documented ranges. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure coverage for the updated functionalities.

items.title: Enhance TodoWrite Rendering as Checklist in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a new rendering branch for TodoWrite calls, transforming them into a checklist format for better readability. Key features include progress indicators, strikethrough for completed items, and mobile-friendly design constraints. Additionally, five new internationalization keys have been added to support multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance AiChat v2 with New Conversation Controls in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update syncs the AiChat tool with the latest documentation for v2 conversation controls, adding new input fields such as `async`, `callback_url`, and more. The changes ensure that existing functionality remains intact while extending the request payload builder to accommodate these new fields. Additionally, the AiChat usage guide has been updated to reflect these enhancements, along with new contract coverage and tests to verify the correct behavior.

items.title: Sync API Contract by Removing Redundant Field in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the `unattended_policy.mode` field from the API contract, addressing redundancy and preventing potential bugs. The documentation now accurately reflects that authorization is solely determined by the lists of allowed skills and servers, eliminating confusion for API consumers. Key changes include updates to the OpenAPI specification and relevant documentation.

items.title: Streamline Unattended Policy by Removing Redundant Mode in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update eliminates the redundant `unattended_policy.mode` field, simplifying the authorization process. The authorization is now solely determined by the presence of skills in the list, preventing potential conflicts and ensuring clarity in task permissions. Key changes include adjustments in multiple handler files and the introduction of a migration script to clean up existing data.

items.title: Refactor Browser Epoch Logic and Fix Revocation Issues in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the outdated BrowserDeviceEpoch and BrowserConnectionEpoch models, along with associated migration and code adjustments. Key improvements include fixing two existing revocation defects that could allow leases to remain active after a device is revoked, enhancing overall security and reliability. The changes have been validated with new test cases ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Rename Devices with Cloud Sync in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the ability to rename devices in the Coding Bridge interface, with names stored in the cloud for seamless synchronization across all user devices. Key changes include a new UI button for renaming, backend modifications to handle name updates, and extensive internationalization support across 17 locales. The implementation ensures that renaming is reflected in real-time on all connected devices, enhancing user experience.

items.title: Enhance Device Renaming for Seamless Sync in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new PATCH endpoint for renaming devices, allowing users to change device names that sync across multiple platforms. Key changes include modifications to the MongoDB schema to store names, updates to the connection handling logic, and the addition of tests to ensure functionality. The implementation ensures that device names are consistent and visible across all user devices, enhancing user experience.

items.title: Documentation Update and PR Progress in Index 🚀
items.summary: The documentation for the browser-device bridge has been updated to clarify the rollback capabilities of R1. A total of 16 PRs have been merged, resulting in a net reduction of approximately 1,400 lines of dead code and the implementation of three new safeguards. Notably, a bug fix was made to ensure that failed extension frames are properly handled.

items.title: Enhance Navigation Handling for Cross-Origin in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the navigation handling for cross-origin requests in the extension, ensuring that the session authority checks align with the allowed origins. Key changes include adjustments to the `resolve()` and `settleNavigation()` functions to enhance security and reliability. The implementation now accurately reflects the real tab location and prevents unauthorized access during navigation.

items.title: Fix session origin updates for cross-subdomain navigation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the browser automation could read but not publish due to session origin not updating across subdomains. Key changes include enhancements to the session manager and facade tool to ensure correct origin tracking and improved error handling for pending states. The modifications ensure smoother navigation and command execution across different subdomains, significantly improving the user experience.

items.title: Automatic Refresh for Scheduled Task Records in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a silent refresh mechanism for the scheduled task records page, ensuring that users see the most current status without needing to navigate away. The page now refreshes every 12 seconds while tasks are queued or running, eliminating the display of outdated 'running' statuses. Additionally, various timeout and error handling improvements have been implemented to enhance reliability.

items.title: Enhance session title accuracy in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the accuracy of session titles displayed in the history drawer by ensuring that the correct titles from all providers, including Claude, are utilized. Key changes include reading the `ai-title` from Claude sessions and unifying the title display for Codex. Additionally, error handling has been enhanced to prevent a single bad file from affecting the entire session list.

items.title: Clean Up Legacy Epoch Data in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the internal remnants of the legacy family A epoch from the browser relay, streamlining the codebase. Key changes include the deletion of unnecessary fields and adjustments in multiple scripts to ensure compatibility. The refactor enhances overall system performance and maintains backward compatibility for existing extensions.

items.title: Enhance Signature Validation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical security risks identified during the review process by implementing unique frame signature determination and adding missing signature gate tests. Key changes include modifications to the signing logic and the introduction of a new test file to ensure robust signature validation. Overall, these enhancements improve the security and reliability of the browser relay functionality.

items.title: Fix result frame handling for signature verification in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where the result frame was not explicitly including `result` and `artifact_refs`, leading to silent failures in command execution. By ensuring these fields are always present, the relay can now correctly verify signatures, preventing timeout issues. Comprehensive tests confirm that the changes maintain expected behavior and improve reliability.

items.title: Fix async handling for typed SDK paths in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug where typed SDK paths were not set to async by default, causing a timeout issue. The `submit()` method now explicitly sets `async_=True` for all typed calls, improving response times from 90 seconds to 0 seconds. Additionally, usage instructions for the sweep tool have been clarified to avoid memory issues during execution.

items.title: Clarify Error Handling for Unavailable Models in S D K 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the handling of structured errors when a model is unavailable, ensuring that the system correctly identifies terminal states. Key changes include differentiating between transient errors and structured error responses across Python, Go, and TypeScript implementations. This enhancement prevents unnecessary polling and improves the clarity of error reporting for users.

items.title: Refactor extension to remove private relay epochs in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update eliminates the `device_epoch` and `connection_epoch` fields from the relay, which were previously private and not sent to devices. The changes include modifications to the command dispatcher and authority verifier, ensuring compatibility with both new and old extensions. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the stability of the implementation.

items.title: Enhance CI for Verified Builds in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new CI job that uploads validated browser extension artifacts, ensuring developers can access the latest builds without manual intervention. Additionally, the README has been updated to guide users on how to properly test these builds and avoid common pitfalls related to stale service workers. These changes aim to reduce misinterpretations of environment issues as code problems during diagnostics.

items.title: Enhance Browser Relay for Epoch Compatibility in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces compatibility for two signing byte formats in the browser relay, allowing both current and migrated devices to function seamlessly. Key changes include the addition of a new method for signing bytes without epoch fields and adjustments to the payload model to set default values for epoch fields. The implementation ensures that devices can continue to validate signatures during the migration process.

items.title: Clarify Navigation Rules for Xiaohongshu in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new explicit rule for handling navigation in Xiaohongshu, emphasizing the need to wait for content to load before reading. Previously, immediate reads after navigation resulted in empty responses, which were incorrectly reported as 'no data'. The change aims to improve data accuracy and user experience.

items.title: Streamlined R1/S1 Migration Plan in Index 🚀
items.summary: The migration plan for R1 and S1 has been established, detailing a three-step process for R1 and an extension of the existing schema for S1. This update includes the successful deletion of approximately 1,200 lines of dead code across seven merged PRs, enhancing overall system efficiency. Key changes ensure cross-repository coordination and improved compatibility for future developments.

items.title: Enhance Cross-Process Contract Testing in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces three new assertions to the cross-process contract tests, ensuring that protocol definitions between relay and aichat2 remain consistent. Key changes include modifications to the CI workflow to trigger tests when relevant files are altered, preventing silent protocol drift. The tests now effectively catch errors that previously went unnoticed during merges.

items.title: Clean Up Dead Tool Protocols in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes obsolete tool command protocols from the extension side, aligning with recent changes in the relay side. A total of 430+ lines of dead code were eliminated, including entire files and unused type definitions, ensuring a cleaner and more efficient codebase. All tests passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the remaining functionality.

items.title: Fix timeout issues and double billing in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical timeout issue where long-running tasks were incorrectly marked as failed, particularly affecting the maestro service, which now has a 45-minute execution limit. Additionally, it addresses a bug that could lead to double billing for users when tasks were prematurely reclaimed. The changes include enhanced service timeout configurations and improved message handling to ensure users are properly notified of task completions.

items.title: Revamped Discord Ace Message Embeds in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the Discord Ace integration by transforming result messages into visually appealing embed cards. Key improvements include the addition of task IDs in message footers, the removal of non-functional buttons, and the implementation of video uploads to ensure proper playback. Overall, these changes streamline user interaction and improve the aesthetic consistency of messages.

items.title: Refactor manifest claims for slim compatibility in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the `required_claims` in the `manifest.json` to align with the current slim architecture. Key changes include the removal of outdated JWT claims and a unified audience for browser-relay verification. The modifications are minimal, ensuring zero runtime risk and maintaining functionality with only three lines altered.

items.title: Enhance Frame Handling for Better Compatibility in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the handling of unknown frame types in the DeviceRelay class, allowing the system to ignore unsupported frames instead of closing the socket. The change improves forward compatibility, enabling the relay to introduce new frame types without disrupting existing extensions. Additionally, the redundant RELAY_ACK_FRAMES whitelist has been removed, streamlining the codebase.

items.title: Streamline Grant Validation by Removing Unused Components in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the signed-grant validation subsystem, which had no active consumers following the deletion of the tool route. Key deletions include several classes and methods related to grant validation, resulting in a net reduction of 197 lines of code. The changes have been validated with all tests passing successfully.
